about: GNI's own database figures, harvested by one read-only query (tools/gni_db_harvest.sql) whose result is ONE cell, copied here unaltered under 'harvest'. Design: docs/S112_RUNTIME_SNAPSHOT_DESIGN.md (DECISION S112-4: DATED facts only). The fitness functions F-DB-PIPE-TOKENS and F-DB-MAD-TOKENS read the highest-numbered snapshot and refuse it when query_md5 does not match the query file in the tree. A DATED fact covers a closed past window and does not go stale.
